title: UFOs Past, Present and Future and the Holloman AFB contact
place_text: Holloman Air Force Base, New Mexico

tellings.quote: contact look they're saying contact yeah with acted military at Hallman Air Force Base in 1972 or 74

related.note: It is the same Serling film, UFOs: Past, Present, and Future, and the same claim that a military base offered UFO footage, but this telling names Edwards AFB, where the story names Holloman AFB.

plain: A 1974 documentary called UFOs: Past, Present and Future is said to deal with contact between alien beings and the military at Holloman Air Force Base in New Mexico, in 1972 or 1974. The UFO investigator James Fox describes it this way to Michels, linking the film to Robert Emenegger, Allan Sandler and Rod Serling: "they're saying contact... with military at Holloman Air Force Base in 1972 or 74." If the film's account were true, the military would have met non-human visitors openly, on a known base.
